pinyin: Tā qǐng wǒmen? Hǎo! Xièxie Xiǎomíng!

pinyin: Bú kèqi. Dàwèi, nǐ qǐng wǒmen!
english: No worries. And David, you can shout us!

english: Me? Er… bye!

english: Xiaoming! Xiaohong! Bye!

english: Bye?

pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ hǎo!
english: Hi, Charlie!

english: Oops, sorry! Hi, hi!

pinyin: Méishì. Qǐng!

english: You're welcome!

pinyin: Bú kèqi?
english: 'You're welcome'?

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Xièxie, xièxie!
english: Sorry! I mean, thanks!

pinyin: Hǎo, Chálǐ, zàijiàn!
english: OK, see you, Charlie!

pinyin: Nǐ hǎo!
english: Hello!

pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ hǎo, zàijiàn! Xièxie, bú kèqi!
english: Charlie: hello-goodbye! Thank-you-you're-welcome!

pinyin: Chálǐ shì xuéshēng. Tā bú rènshi Wáng lǎoshī.
english: Charlie's a student. He doesn't know Teacher Wang yet.

english: Excuse me, are you Teacher Wang?

hanzi: 不是，我是学生。我叫安娜。
pinyin: Bú shì, wǒ shì xuéshēng. Wǒ jiào Ānnà.
english: No, I'm a student. I'm Anna.

hanzi: 对不起！我叫查理。很高兴认识你！
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ jiào Chálǐ. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
english: Oh, sorry! I'm Charlie. Nice to meet you!

pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nín shì lǎoshī ma?
english: Excuse me, are you the teacher?

hanzi: 我？不是！我是美国学生，我叫大卫。
pinyin: Wǒ? Bú shì! Wǒ shì Měiguó xuéshēng, wǒ jiào Dàwèi.
english: Me? No! I'm a student from America. I'm David.

pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì xuéshēng ma?
english: Hi! Are you a student?

pinyin: Nǐ ne? Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
english: And you? Where are you from?

hanzi: 我是澳大利亚人。你叫什么名字？
pinyin: Wǒ shì Àodàlìyà rén. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
english: I'm Australian. What's your name?

pinyin: Wǒ shì Wáng lǎoshī.
english: I'm Teacher Wang.

pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī?! Duìbuqǐ!
english: Teacher Wang?! Sorry!

pinyin: Méi guānxi. Tóngxuémen hǎo!
english: That's all right. Good morning, everyone!

pinyin: Xiǎomíng, nà shì shéi?
english: Xiaoming, who's that?

hanzi: 那是我朋友，小张。他是上海人。
pinyin: Nà shì wǒ péngyou, Xiǎo Zhāng. Tā shì Shànghǎi rén.
english: That's my mate Xiao Zhang. He's from Shanghai.

pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng? Tā hěn xiǎo ma?
english: 'Little' Zhang? Is he little?

hanzi: 他不小！我们是朋友，我叫他小张。
pinyin: Tā bù xiǎo! Wǒmen shì péngyou, wǒ jiào tā Xiǎo Zhāng.
english: He's not little! We're mates, so I call him Xiao Zhang.

pinyin: Zhè shì Xiǎo Lǐ, wǒ tóngxué.
english: And this is Xiao Li, my classmate.

pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ, nǐ hǎo! Xiǎo Zhāng, nǐ hǎo!
english: Hi, Xiao Li! Hi, Xiao Zhang!

hanzi: 这是王老师。查理认识她。
pinyin: Zhè shì Wáng lǎoshī. Chálǐ rènshi tā.
english: Here comes Teacher Wang. Charlie knows her.

pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng, nǐ hǎo!
english: Hi, Xiao Wang!

pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng?
english: Xiao Wang?

pinyin: Chálǐ! Tā shì lǎoshī!
english: Charlie! She's a teacher!

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wáng lǎoshī hǎo!
english: Oops, sorry! Hello, Teacher Wang!

pinyin: Méi guānxi. Nǐ hǎo, xiǎo Chálǐ!
english: Never mind. Hello, little Charlie!

pinyin: Chálǐ, zhè shì Xiǎohóng.
english: Charlie, this is Xiaohong.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì xuéshēng ma?
english: Hi, Xiaohong! Are you a student?

pinyin: Shì! Wǒ jīnnián shí sì suì.
english: Yep! I'm fourteen.

pinyin: Sì shí suì?
english: Forty?

pinyin: Bú shì sì shí, shì shí sì!
english: Not forty, fourteen!

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Shí sì, shí sì.
english: Sorry! Fourteen, fourteen.

pinyin: Nǐ ne? Nǐ jīnnián duōshao suì?
english: And you? How old are you?

pinyin: Wǒ sān shí sì suì.
english: I'm thirty-four.

pinyin: Sì shí sān suì?
english: Forty-three?

pinyin: Bú shì! Shì sān shí sì!
english: No! Thirty-four!

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Sān shí sì, sān shí sì.
english: Sorry! Thirty-four, thirty-four.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng! Nǐmen liǎng gè!
english: Xiaohong! Honestly, you two!

pinyin: Tóngxuémen hǎo! Wǒmen jǐ gè rén?
english: Morning, everyone! How many of us are here?

hanzi: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九。九个人！
pinyin: Yī, èr, sān, sì, wǔ, liù, qī, bā, jiǔ. Jiǔ gè rén!
english: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine. Nine!

pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ ne?
english: Charlie, what about you?

pinyin: Wǒ? Duìbuqǐ! Shí gè rén!
english: Me? Oops, sorry! Ten!

pinyin: Shí gè rén? Nà wǒ ne?
english: Ten? And what about me?

hanzi: 对不起，王老师！十一个人！
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, Wáng lǎoshī! Shí yī gè rén!
english: Sorry, Teacher Wang! Eleven!

pinyin: Lǎoshī hǎo! Duìbuqǐ, duìbuqǐ!
english: Morning, Teacher! Sorry, sorry I'm late!

hanzi: 一、二……十二！我们十二个人！
pinyin: Yī, èr…… shí èr! Wǒmen shí èr gè rén!
english: One, two… twelve! There are twelve of us!

pinyin: Hěn hǎo, Chálǐ!
english: Very good, Charlie!

pinyin: Chálǐ, zhè shì nǐ de jiārén ma?
english: Charlie, is this your family?

pinyin: Shì, zhè shì wǒ bàba hé māma.
english: Yep, that's my dad and mum.

pinyin: Tā shì shéi?
english: Who's she?

hanzi: 她是我姐姐。她有两个孩子，一男一女。
pinyin: Tā shì wǒ jiějie. Tā yǒu liǎng gè háizi, yì nán yì nǚ.
english: That's my sister. She's got two kids, a boy and a girl.

pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
english: How many are there in your family?

hanzi: 五口人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐、我和弟弟。
pinyin: Wǔ kǒu rén: bàba, māma, jiějie, wǒ hé dìdi.
english: Five: Dad, Mum, my sister, me and my little brother.

pinyin: Nǐ dìdi ne?
english: And where's your little brother?

pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dìdi!
english: This is my little brother!

pinyin: Chálǐ, tā shì gǒu!
english: Charlie, that's a dog!

hanzi: 是，它是我的狗，也是我弟弟！
pinyin: Shì, tā shì wǒ de gǒu, yě shì wǒ dìdi!
english: Yep. He's my dog, and he's my little brother!

pinyin: Hǎo…… wǒ yě yǒu yí gè mèimei.
english: Fair enough… I've got a little sister too.

hanzi: 你有妹妹？她叫什么名字？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu mèimei? Tā jiào shénme míngzi?
english: You've got a sister? What's her name?

pinyin: Tā…… tā shì yì zhī māo.
english: She's… well, she's a cat.

hanzi: 查理，你好！你爸爸妈妈都好吗？
pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ bàba māma dōu hǎo ma?
english: Morning, Charlie! How are your mum and dad?

pinyin: Tāmen dōu hěn hǎo, xièxie nín!
english: They're both well, thanks!

pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ jīnnián duōshao suì?
english: Charlie, how old are you now?

pinyin: Sān shí sì suì.
english: Thirty-four.

pinyin: Nǐ yǒu háizi ma?
english: Got any kids?

pinyin: Méiyǒu.
english: No.

hanzi: 我有一个儿子和一个女儿。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí gè érzi hé yí gè nǚ'ér.
english: I've got a son and a daughter, you know.

hanzi: 我女儿今年三十二岁，也没有孩子……
pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián sān shí èr suì, yě méiyǒu háizi……
english: My daughter's thirty-two. No kids either…

pinyin: Nín nǚ'ér yǒu gǒu ma?
english: Has your daughter got a dog?

pinyin: Gǒu? Yǒu, tā yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
english: A dog? Yes, she's got a little dog.

hanzi: 它是女孩子吗？我的狗是男孩子！
pinyin: Tā shì nǚ háizi ma? Wǒ de gǒu shì nán háizi!
english: Is it a girl? My dog's a boy!

pinyin: Chálǐ! Wǒ nǚ'ér bú shì gǒu!
english: Charlie! I'm on about my daughter, not the dog!

hanzi: 二零二六年十一月十三日，星期五。
pinyin: Èr líng èr liù nián shí yī yuè shí sān rì, xīngqī wǔ.
english: Friday, 13 November 2026.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng, zǎoshang hǎo! Jīntiān jǐ hào?
english: Morning, Xiaohong! What's the date today?

pinyin: Shí sān hào.
english: The 13th.

pinyin: Shí sān hào? Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?
english: The 13th? And what day is it?

pinyin: Xīngqī wǔ.
english: Friday.

hanzi: 星期五，十三号……不好，不好！
pinyin: Xīngqī wǔ, shí sān hào…… bù hǎo, bù hǎo!
english: Friday the 13th… Uh-oh. That's bad luck!

hanzi: 不好？今天很好！我今天十六岁！
pinyin: Bù hǎo? Jīntiān hěn hǎo! Wǒ jīntiān shí liù suì!
english: Bad luck? Today's great! I turn sixteen today!

pinyin: Jīntiān? Nǐ shí liù suì?
english: Today? You're sixteen?

pinyin: Shì! Zuótiān shí wǔ, jīntiān shí liù!
english: Yep! Fifteen yesterday, sixteen today!

pinyin: Nà jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ qǐng nǐ!
english: Then tonight's my shout!

hanzi: 谢谢查理！那今天好不好？
pinyin: Xièxie Chálǐ! Nà jīntiān hǎo bu hǎo?
english: Thanks, Charlie! So is today good or bad?

pinyin: Xīngqī wǔ, shí sān hào…… hěn hǎo!
english: Friday the 13th… it's a great day!

pinyin: Chálǐ, míngtiān zhōngwǔ wǒ qǐng nǐ!
english: Charlie, lunch tomorrow is on me!

pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān xīngqī jǐ?
english: Thanks! What day is tomorrow?

pinyin: Xīngqītiān, shí yī yuè shí wǔ hào.
english: Sunday, the 15th of November.

hanzi: 好！那星期日中午我请你！
pinyin: Hǎo! Nà xīngqīrì zhōngwǔ wǒ qǐng nǐ!
english: Great! Then on xīngqīrì, lunch is on me!

pinyin: Xīngqīrì?
english: Xīngqīrì?

hanzi: 是。星期天是第七天，星期日是第八天！
pinyin: Shì. Xīngqītiān shì dì qī tiān, xīngqīrì shì dì bā tiān!
english: Yep. Sunday's the seventh day, and xīngqīrì's the eighth!

pinyin: Chálǐ, yí gè xīngqī yǒu jǐ tiān?
english: Charlie, how many days are there in a week?

hanzi: 七天……那星期日是星期天？
pinyin: Qī tiān…… nà xīngqīrì shì xīngqītiān?
english: Seven… so xīngqīrì is Sunday?

hanzi: 是！星期日和星期天是一天！
pinyin: Shì! Xīngqīrì hé xīngqītiān shì yì tiān!
english: Yes! Xīngqīrì and xīngqītiān are the same day!

hanzi: 那明天中午，你请我，我也请你！
pinyin: Nà míngtiān zhōngwǔ, nǐ qǐng wǒ, wǒ yě qǐng nǐ!
english: Then tomorrow at lunch, you shout me and I shout you!

pinyin: Hǎo! Yì rén yíbàn!
english: Deal! We'll go halves!

hanzi: 星期一晚上八点，大卫下班。
pinyin: Xīngqī yī wǎnshang bā diǎn, Dàwèi xiàbān.
english: Eight o'clock on Monday night. David has just finished work.

pinyin: Dàwèi, nǐ xiànzài xiàbān? Hěn wǎn!
english: David, you're only knocking off now? That's late!

pinyin: Shì, jīntiān gōngsī hěn máng.
english: Yeah, it's been flat out at the office today.

hanzi: 我早上九点上班，晚上八点下班。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, wǎnshang bā diǎn xiàbān.
english: I started at nine this morning and finished at eight tonight.

pinyin: Nǐ gōngzuò shí yī gè xiǎoshí!
english: You worked eleven hours!

pinyin: Shì. Nǐ ne? Nǐ jīntiān máng ma?
english: Yep. What about you? Were you busy today?

pinyin: Hěn máng! Wǒ jīntiān qǐchuáng hěn zǎo.
english: Very! I got up really early today.

pinyin: Jǐ diǎn?
english: What time?

pinyin: Wǔ diǎn.
english: Five.

pinyin: Wǔ diǎn? Hěn zǎo!
english: Five? That's early!

pinyin: Shì, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn!
english: Yep. Five in the afternoon!

hanzi: 下午五点？那你几点睡觉？
pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn? Nà nǐ jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
english: Five in the afternoon? So what time did you go to bed?

pinyin: Zǎoshang liù diǎn bàn.
english: Half past six in the morning.

pinyin: Nǐ shuì shí gè bàn xiǎoshí?
english: You slept ten and a half hours?

pinyin: Shì! Nǐ máng gōngzuò, wǒ máng shuìjiào!
english: Yep! You were busy working, and I was busy sleeping!

hanzi: 七点四十，小红的爸爸在睡觉。
pinyin: Qī diǎn sì shí, Xiǎohóng de bàba zài shuìjiào.
english: 7:40 am. Xiaohong's dad is still asleep.

hanzi: 爸爸，起床！现在七点四十！
pinyin: Bàba, qǐchuáng! Xiànzài qī diǎn sì shí!
english: Dad, get up! It's twenty to eight!

pinyin: Wǔ fēnzhōng……
english: Five more minutes…

pinyin: Qī diǎn sì shí wǔ fēn.
Bàba! Nǐ jǐ diǎn shàngbān?
english: Dad! What time do you start work?

pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn. Shí fēnzhōng……
english: Half past eight. Ten more minutes…

pinyin: Qī diǎn wǔ shí wǔ fēn.
Bàba! Qī diǎn wǔ shí wǔ!
english: Dad! It's five to eight!

hanzi: 七点五十五？很晚！我去上班！
pinyin: Qī diǎn wǔ shí wǔ? Hěn wǎn! Wǒ qù shàngbān!
english: Five to eight? I'm late! I'm off to work!

pinyin: Bàba, jīntiān shì xīngqī liù.
english: Dad… it's Saturday today.

hanzi: 星期六？我不上班！……我睡觉！
pinyin: Xīngqī liù? Wǒ bú shàngbān!…… Wǒ shuìjiào!
english: Saturday? No work today! … I'm going back to bed!

pinyin: Hǎo, bàba, wǔ fēnzhōng!
english: Sure, Dad. Five minutes!

hanzi: 晚上七点，大卫在查理家。
pinyin: Wǎnshang qī diǎn, Dàwèi zài Chálǐ jiā.
english: Seven in the evening. David's over at Charlie's place.

pinyin: Chálǐ, wǒ hěn xiǎng chī fàn!
english: Charlie, I'm starving!

pinyin: Hǎo, jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ zuò fàn ba!
english: No worries, I'll cook tonight!

pinyin: Dàwèi, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme cài?
english: What do you feel like, David?

pinyin: Jiǎozi!
english: Dumplings!

pinyin: Wǒ jiā méiyǒu jiǎozi.
english: There aren't any dumplings at my place.

pinyin: Miàntiáor ne?
english: Noodles, then?

pinyin: Yě méiyǒu.
english: None of those either.

pinyin: Mǐfàn ne?
english: Rice?

hanzi: 没有米饭。我有鸡蛋和面包！
pinyin: Méiyǒu mǐfàn. Wǒ yǒu jīdàn hé miànbāo!
english: No rice. But I've got eggs and bread!

pinyin: Jīdàn? Hǎo ba……
english: Eggs? Oh well…

pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Niúnǎi?
english: What would you like to drink? Milk?

pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ yào yì bēi niúnǎi.
english: Yes please, a glass of milk.

hanzi: 对不起，没有牛奶。我们喝茶吧！
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, méiyǒu niúnǎi. Wǒmen hē chá ba!
english: Sorry, there's no milk. Let's have tea!

pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ jiā yǒu shénme?
english: Charlie, what have you actually got here?

hanzi: 鸡蛋、面包、茶……和很多杯子！
pinyin: Jīdàn, miànbāo, chá…… hé hěn duō bēizi!
english: Eggs, bread, tea… and lots of cups!

hanzi: 大卫，这是你的第八个鸡蛋！
pinyin: Dàwèi, zhè shì nǐ de dì bā gè jīdàn!
english: David, that's your eighth egg!

hanzi: 查理，你做的鸡蛋很好吃！
pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ zuò de jīdàn hěn hǎochī!
english: Charlie, your eggs are delicious!

pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang wǒ qǐng nǐ ba!
english: Tomorrow night's my shout!

pinyin: Hǎo! Míngtiān wǒmen chī jiǎozi ba!
english: Great! Let's have dumplings tomorrow!

hanzi: 中午十二点，查理和小红吃午饭。
pinyin: Zhōngwǔ shí èr diǎn, Chálǐ hé Xiǎohóng chī wǔfàn.
english: Twelve noon. Charlie and Xiaohong sit down to lunch.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng, nǐ de wǔfàn ne?
english: Xiaohong, where's your lunch?

pinyin: Yí gè píngguǒ, yì bēi shuǐ.
english: One apple and a glass of water.

pinyin: Nǐ bù chī fàn ma?
english: Aren't you having a proper meal?

hanzi: 不吃。我早饭、午饭、晚饭都吃水果！
pinyin: Bù chī. Wǒ zǎofàn, wǔfàn, wǎnfàn dōu chī shuǐguǒ!
english: Nope. Breakfast, lunch and dinner, it's all fruit for me!

hanzi: 我的包子很好吃。你要吗？
pinyin: Wǒ de bāozi hěn hǎochī. Nǐ yào ma?
english: My buns are really good. Want one?

pinyin: Bú yào, xièxie. Wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
english: No thanks. I'm not hungry.

english: Yeah, that's where I do my shopping.

pinyin: Nà chāoshì hòubiān shì shénme?
english: So what's behind the supermarket?

pinyin: Chāoshì hòubiān shì yì jiā fàndiàn.
english: Behind the supermarket is a restaurant.

pinyin: Shì tā! Shì nà jiā fàndiàn!
english: That's it! That's the restaurant!

pinyin: Chálǐ! Tā zài nǐ jiā hòubiān!
english: Charlie! It's right behind your own place!

hanzi: 对不起，对不起！我们去吃面条儿吧！
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, duìbuqǐ! Wǒmen qù chī miàntiáor ba!
english: Sorry, sorry! Come on, let's go and get those noodles!

hanzi: 好！哥哥，我们晚一点儿回家！
pinyin: Hǎo! Gēge, wǒmen wǎn yìdiǎnr huí jiā!
english: Yes! We can go home a bit later, bro!

hanzi: 十二月，查理回悉尼见家人。
pinyin: Shí èr yuè, Chálǐ huí Xīní jiàn jiārén.
english: In December, Charlie goes home to Sydney to see his family.

pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě qù Xīní wán.
english: Xiaoming's coming along for a holiday.

hanzi: 查理，十二月悉尼冷不冷？
pinyin: Chálǐ, shí èr yuè Xīní lěng bu lěng?
english: Charlie, is Sydney cold in December?

pinyin: Bù lěng, fēicháng rè!
english: Cold? No, it's boiling!

pinyin: Shí èr yuè hěn rè? Zhēn de ma?
english: Hot, in December? Really?

hanzi: 真的。北京冷的时候，悉尼很热。
pinyin: Zhēn de. Běijīng lěng de shíhou, Xīní hěn rè.
english: Really. When it's cold in Beijing, it's hot in Sydney.

hanzi: 悉尼白天非常热，晚上也不冷。
pinyin: Xīní báitiān fēicháng rè, wǎnshang yě bù lěng.
english: Sydney's really hot in the daytime, and it's not cold at night either.

hanzi: 他们去悉尼的那天，北京下雪了。
pinyin: Tāmen qù Xīní de nà tiān, Běijīng xià xuě le.
english: The day they fly to Sydney, it's snowing in Beijing.

pinyin: Xiǎomíng chuān le sì jiàn yīfu.
english: Xiaoming has put on four layers.

pinyin: Xiǎomíng, sì jiàn yīfu?
english: Xiaoming, four layers?

pinyin: Jīntiān fēicháng lěng!
english: It's freezing today!

hanzi: 十二个小时后，飞机到了悉尼。
pinyin: Shí èr gè xiǎoshí hòu, fēijī dào le Xīní.
english: Twelve hours later, the plane lands in Sydney.

hanzi: 悉尼的天气非常好，也非常热。
pinyin: Xīní de tiānqì fēicháng hǎo, yě fēicháng rè.
english: The weather in Sydney is beautiful, and very hot.

pinyin: Zhēn rè! Tài rè le!
english: It's so hot! Way too hot!

pinyin: Wǒ juéde jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo!
english: I reckon it's a lovely day!

pinyin: Nǐ juéde…… bú rè?
english: You don't think… it's hot?

hanzi: 不热！是你穿的衣服太多了。
pinyin: Bú rè! Shì nǐ chuān de yīfu tài duō le.
english: It's not hot! You've just got too many clothes on.

hanzi: 我的衣服，都是冷天穿的！
pinyin: Wǒ de yīfu, dōu shì lěng tiān chuān de!
english: All my clothes are for cold weather!

hanzi: 没关系，你穿我的衣服吧！
pinyin: Méi guānxi, nǐ chuān wǒ de yīfu ba!
english: No worries, wear mine!

hanzi: 查理的衣服，小明穿有点儿大。
pinyin: Chálǐ de yīfu, Xiǎomíng chuān yǒudiǎnr dà.
english: Charlie's clothes are a bit big on Xiaoming.

hanzi: 大一点儿没关系！我不热了！
pinyin: Dà yìdiǎnr méi guānxi! Wǒ bú rè le!
english: A bit big? Who cares! I'm not hot any more!

pinyin: Xīní de shí èr yuè zhēn hǎo!
english: December in Sydney is great!

hanzi: 十一月的一天早上，查理起床了。
pinyin: Shí yī yuè de yì tiān zǎoshang, Chálǐ qǐchuáng le.
english: One November morning, Charlie gets out of bed.

pinyin: Wàibian dōu shì xuě!
english: There's snow everywhere outside!

pinyin: Xià xuě le! Běijīng xià xuě le!
english: It's snowing! It's snowing in Beijing!

hanzi: 悉尼不下雪，查理非常高兴。
pinyin: Xīní bú xià xuě, Chálǐ fēicháng gāoxìng.
english: It never snows in Sydney, so Charlie's over the moon.

hanzi: 他穿了一件衣服，去外边玩。
pinyin: Tā chuān le yí jiàn yīfu, qù wàibian wán.
english: He throws on one layer and goes out to play.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng yě zài wàibian.
english: Xiaohong's outside too.

hanzi: 查理，一件衣服？你不冷吗？
pinyin: Chálǐ, yí jiàn yīfu? Nǐ bù lěng ma?
english: Charlie, just one layer? Aren't you cold?

pinyin: Bù lěng! Běijīng de xuě zhēn piàoliang!
english: Not at all! Beijing snow is gorgeous!

pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng hòu……
english: Ten minutes later…

pinyin: Tài lěng le! Wǒ huí jiā chuān yīfu!
english: It's freezing! I'm going home to put more clothes on!

hanzi: 半个小时后，查理回来了。
pinyin: Bàn gè xiǎoshí hòu, Chálǐ huí lái le.
english: Half an hour later, Charlie's back.

pinyin: Tā chuān le wǔ jiàn yīfu!
english: He's wearing five layers!

pinyin: Xuě ne?
english: Where's the snow gone?

pinyin: Xiànzài bú xià xuě le, xià yǔ le!
english: It's stopped snowing. Now it's raining!

pinyin: Yǔ fēicháng dà.
english: And it's bucketing down.

hanzi: 查理，你觉得北京的天气怎么样？
pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ juéde Běijīng de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
english: So, Charlie, what do you reckon of Beijing weather?

pinyin: Wǒ juéde…… wǒ huí jiā hē rè chá!
english: I reckon… I'm going home for a hot cup of tea!

hanzi: 星期六下午，查理在小明家学中文。
pinyin: Xīngqī liù xiàwǔ, Chálǐ zài Xiǎomíng jiā xué Zhōngwén.
english: Saturday afternoon. Charlie's at Xiaoming's place, studying Chinese.

hanzi: 他写了一个小时的汉字。
pinyin: Tā xiě le yí gè xiǎoshí de Hànzì.
english: He's spent an hour writing characters.

hanzi: 小明的妹妹小红下课回来了。
pinyin: Xiǎomíng de mèimei Xiǎohóng xiàkè huí lái le.
english: Xiaoming's little sister, Xiaohong, gets home from school.

hanzi: 她是中学生，很会写汉字。
pinyin: Tā shì zhōngxuéshēng, hěn huì xiě Hànzì.
english: She's in high school, and she's great at writing characters.

hanzi: 查理，这些字都是你写的吗？
pinyin: Chálǐ, zhèxiē zì dōu shì nǐ xiě de ma?
english: Charlie, did you write all these?

pinyin: Duì. Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
english: Yep. What do you reckon?

hanzi: 有的字好看，有的不好看。
pinyin: Yǒude zì hǎokàn, yǒude bù hǎokàn.
english: Some of them look good, some don't.

pinyin: Zhège zì bú duì.
english: This one's wrong.

pinyin: Nǎge zì bú duì?
english: Which one?

pinyin: Nǐ xiě de shì: wǒ xiǎng mài shuǐguǒ.
english: You've written: 'I want to sell fruit.'

hanzi: 我想买水果，不想卖水果！
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, bù xiǎng mài shuǐguǒ!
english: I want to buy fruit, not sell it!

hanzi: 卖字上边有个十，买字没有。
pinyin: Mài zì shàngbiān yǒu gè shí, mǎi zì méiyǒu.
english: 卖 (sell) has a 十 on top. 买 (buy) doesn't.

pinyin: Duì, duì! Xièxie xiǎo lǎoshī!
english: Oh, right! Thanks, little teacher!

hanzi: 不客气。你的茶字非常好看！
pinyin: Bú kèqi. Nǐ de chá zì fēicháng hǎokàn!
english: No worries. Your 茶 (tea) looks really nice, though!

hanzi: 我天天喝茶，也天天写茶字。
pinyin: Wǒ tiān tiān hē chá, yě tiān tiān xiě chá zì.
english: I drink tea every day, so I write it every day too.

hanzi: 这时候，小明也下课回来了。
pinyin: Zhè shíhou, Xiǎomíng yě xiàkè huí lái le.
english: Just then, Xiaoming gets home from class too.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng, nǐ jīntiān xuéxí le ma?
english: Xiaohong, have you done any study today?

hanzi: 今天我是老师，不是学生！
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ shì lǎoshī, bú shì xuéshēng!
english: Today I'm the teacher, not the student!

hanzi: 老师也要学习。去写你的字吧！
pinyin: Lǎoshī yě yào xuéxí. Qù xiě nǐ de zì ba!
english: Teachers have to study too. Off you go and practise your characters!

hanzi: 星期一上午八点，上课了。
pinyin: Xīngqī yī shàngwǔ bā diǎn, shàngkè le.
english: Monday, eight a.m. Class is starting.

hanzi: 同学们好！今天我们学第十三课。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen hǎo! Jīntiān wǒmen xué dì shí sān kè.
english: Morning, everyone! Today we're doing Lesson Thirteen.

hanzi: 上课的时候，我们都说汉语。
pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, wǒmen dōu shuō Hànyǔ.
english: In class, we all speak Chinese.

hanzi: 大卫呢？他今天不上课吗？
pinyin: Dàwèi ne? Tā jīntiān bú shàngkè ma?
english: Where's David? Isn't he coming to class today?

hanzi: 他起床很晚，上课的时候也睡觉！
pinyin: Tā qǐchuáng hěn wǎn, shàngkè de shíhou yě shuìjiào!
english: He gets up late, and he sleeps through class anyway!

pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn, Dàwèi lái shàngkè le.
english: At half past eight, David turns up for class.

hanzi: 对不起，王老师！我去了一个小学。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, Wáng lǎoshī! Wǒ qù le yí gè xiǎoxué.
english: Sorry, Teacher Wang! I ended up at a primary school.

pinyin: Xiǎoxué? Nǐ qù xiǎoxué zuò shénme?
english: A primary school? What were you doing there?

pinyin: Wǒ zuò chūzūchē, shuō: qù xuéxiào!
english: I got a taxi and said, 'To school, please!'

hanzi: 开车的人没有说话，开到了小学。
pinyin: Kāichē de rén méiyǒu shuōhuà, kāi dào le xiǎoxué.
english: The driver didn't say a word. He just drove me to a primary school.

hanzi: 北京有很多学校：小学、中学、大学……
pinyin: Běijīng yǒu hěn duō xuéxiào: xiǎoxué, zhōngxué, dàxué……
english: Beijing's got heaps of schools: primary schools, high schools, unis...

pinyin: Nǐ yào shuō xuéxiào de míngzi.
english: You have to say the name of the school.

hanzi: 那些小学生都说：新老师好！
pinyin: Nàxiē xiǎoxuéshēng dōu shuō: xīn lǎoshī hǎo!
english: All the kids said, 'Good morning, new teacher!'

hanzi: 我说：我不是老师，我是大学生！
pinyin: Wǒ shuō: wǒ bú shì lǎoshī, wǒ shì dàxuéshēng!
english: I said, 'I'm not a teacher, I'm a uni student!'

pinyin: Hǎo, Dàwèi lǎoshī, qǐng zuò.
english: Right then, Teacher David, take a seat.

pinyin: Xiànzài, qǐng nǐ dú dì shí sān kè!
english: And now you can read Lesson Thirteen for us!

hanzi: 星期六晚上，小明和小红来查理家。
pinyin: Xīngqī liù wǎnshang, Xiǎomíng hé Xiǎohóng lái Chálǐ jiā.
english: Saturday night. Xiaoming and Xiaohong come over to Charlie's.

pinyin: Chálǐ de xiǎo gǒu fēicháng gāoxìng.
english: Charlie's dog is over the moon.

hanzi: 查理，你晚上喜欢做什么？
pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ wǎnshang xǐhuan zuò shénme?
english: Charlie, what do you like doing in the evenings?

hanzi: 我喜欢看电影，还喜欢听歌。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng, hái xǐhuan tīng gē.
english: I like watching films, and I like music, too.

pinyin: Wǒ ài chàng gē! Nǐmen tīng!
english: I love singing! Listen!

hanzi: 小红在手机上找了一个中国歌。
pinyin: Xiǎohóng zài shǒujī shàng zhǎo le yí gè Zhōngguó gē.
english: Xiaohong finds a Chinese song on her phone.

pinyin: Tā chàng gē fēicháng hǎotīng.
english: She's got a beautiful voice.

pinyin: Tài hǎotīng le! Wǒ néng xué ma?
english: That's gorgeous! Can I learn it?

pinyin: Kěyǐ! Wǒ chàng, nǐ yě chàng.
english: Sure! I'll sing, then you sing.

pinyin: Xiǎohóng chàng le, Chálǐ yě chàng le.
english: Xiaohong sings a line, then Charlie has a go.

pinyin: Zhè shíhou, xiǎo gǒu yě jiào le.
english: Just then, the dog starts howling too.

pinyin: Nǐmen kàn, tā yě ài zhège gē!
english: See? It loves this song too!

pinyin: Bú duì, tā bù xǐhuan nǐ chàng gē!
english: Nope. It just doesn't like YOUR singing!

pinyin: Xiǎohóng, nǐ shuō shénme ne!
english: Xiaohong! What a thing to say!

pinyin: Méi guānxi. Wǒmen kàn diànshì ba!
english: That's all right. Let's watch some TV!

hanzi: 电视上有一个好玩儿的电影。
pinyin: Diànshì shàng yǒu yí gè hǎowánr de diànyǐng.
english: There's a fun film on TV.

hanzi: 他们看电影的时候，小狗睡觉了。
pinyin: Tāmen kàn diànyǐng de shíhou, xiǎo gǒu shuìjiào le.
english: While they watch the film, the dog falls asleep.

hanzi: 大卫很爱看电影，安娜喜欢读书。
pinyin: Dàwèi hěn ài kàn diànyǐng, Ānnà xǐhuan dúshū.
english: David loves films. Anna likes reading.

hanzi: 安娜，今天晚上去看电影吧！
pinyin: Ānnà, jīntiān wǎnshang qù kàn diànyǐng ba!
english: Anna, let's go and see a film tonight!

pinyin: Shénme diànyǐng?
english: What film?

hanzi: 叫小猫回家，非常好玩儿！
pinyin: Jiào xiǎo māo huí jiā, fēicháng hǎowánr!
english: It's called The Kitten Goes Home. It's heaps of fun!

hanzi: 我读了那本书！我也想看。
pinyin: Wǒ dú le nà běn shū! Wǒ yě xiǎng kàn.
english: I've read the book! I'd love to see it.

pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Qī diǎn, diànyǐngyuàn jiàn!
english: Great! See you at the cinema at seven!

hanzi: 晚上七点，他们到了电影院。
pinyin: Wǎnshang qī diǎn, tāmen dào le diànyǐngyuàn.
english: At seven they meet at the cinema.

hanzi: 电影院里，大卫买了很多好吃的。
pinyin: Diànyǐngyuàn lǐ, Dàwèi mǎi le hěn duō hǎochī de.
english: Inside, David buys a mountain of snacks.

hanzi: 电影里，小猫找不到家了。
pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ, xiǎo māo zhǎo bú dào jiā le.
english: In the film, the kitten can't find its way home.

pinyin: Tā de jiā zài yí gè shūdiàn lǐ!
english: Its home is in a bookshop!

pinyin: Ānnà! Nǐ bù néng shuō!
english: Anna! You can't tell me!

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ bù shuō le.
english: Sorry! I won't say another word.

hanzi: 九点半，他们在电影院外边。
pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn bàn, tāmen zài diànyǐngyuàn wàibian.
english: At half past nine they're outside the cinema.

pinyin: Ānnà, xiǎo māo huí jiā le ma?
english: Anna, did the kitten make it home?

pinyin: Nǐ méiyǒu kàn diànyǐng ma?
english: Didn't you watch the film?

hanzi: 我吃了很多，睡了一个小时。
pinyin: Wǒ chī le hěn duō, shuì le yí gè xiǎoshí.
english: I ate heaps, then slept for an hour.

pinyin: Nà xiànzài wǒ kěyǐ shuō le ba?
english: So NOW can I tell you?

hanzi: 查理在李女士的店里买茶。
pinyin: Chálǐ zài Lǐ nǚshì de diàn lǐ mǎi chá.
english: Charlie's buying tea in Ms Li's shop.

hanzi: 这时候，有人给他打电话。
pinyin: Zhè shíhou, yǒu rén gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
english: Just then, his phone rings.

pinyin: Shì Ānnà de diànhuà.
english: It's Anna.

pinyin: Wèi, Ānnà! Shénme shì?
english: Hi, Anna! What's up?

hanzi: 查理，你明天下午有时间吗？
pinyin: Chálǐ, nǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān ma?
english: Charlie, are you free tomorrow afternoon?

pinyin: Yǒu shíjiān! Wǒmen qù nǎr?
english: Yep! Where are we going?

pinyin: Wǒmen qù shūdiàn ba, liǎng diǎn jiàn!
english: Let's go to the bookshop. See you at two!

hanzi: 查理，安娜是你的女朋友吗？
pinyin: Chálǐ, Ānnà shì nǐ de nǚpéngyou ma?
english: Charlie, is Anna your girlfriend?

hanzi: 不是，李女士！她是我的同学。
pinyin: Bú shì, Lǐ nǚshì! Tā shì wǒ de tóngxué.
english: No, Ms Li! She's my classmate.

pinyin: Nà nǐ yǒu nǚpéngyou ma?
english: So have you got a girlfriend?

hanzi: 李女士，你的问题太多了！
pinyin: Lǐ nǚshì, nǐ de wèntí tài duō le!
english: Ms Li, you ask too many questions!

hanzi: 我先生的朋友有一个女儿。
pinyin: Wǒ xiānsheng de péngyou yǒu yí gè nǚ'ér.
english: My husband's friend has a daughter.

hanzi: 她非常漂亮，也是大学生。
pinyin: Tā fēicháng piàoliang, yě shì dàxuéshēng.
english: She's very pretty, and she's at uni too.

pinyin: Xièxie nín, wǒ yǒu nǚpéngyou le.
english: Thanks, but I've already got a girlfriend.

pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Tā xǐhuan shénme?
english: Really? What's she into?

hanzi: 她喜欢吃，喜欢睡觉，也喜欢我。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan chī, xǐhuan shuìjiào, yě xǐhuan wǒ.
english: She likes eating, sleeping, and me.

pinyin: Tā zài nǎge gōngsī gōngzuò?
english: Which company does she work for?

hanzi: 她不工作。她是我的小狗！
pinyin: Tā bù gōngzuò. Tā shì wǒ de xiǎo gǒu!
english: She doesn't work. She's my dog!

hanzi: 那我给你的小狗找一个男朋友吧！
pinyin: Nà wǒ gěi nǐ de xiǎo gǒu zhǎo yí gè nánpéngyou ba!
english: Well then, I'll find your dog a boyfriend!

hanzi: 星期三晚上，查理的电脑有问题。
pinyin: Xīngqī sān wǎnshang, Chálǐ de diànnǎo yǒu wèntí.
english: Wednesday night. Something's wrong with Charlie's computer.

pinyin: Tā gěi Xiǎomíng dǎ diànhuà.
english: He rings Xiaoming.

hanzi: 喂，小明，你现在有时间吗？
pinyin: Wèi, Xiǎomíng, nǐ xiànzài yǒu shíjiān ma?
english: Hi, Xiaoming. Have you got a minute?

pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ zhèngzài shàngkè ne.
english: Sorry, I'm in class right now.

pinyin: Hǎo, méishì. Nǐ shàngkè ba!
english: OK, no worries. Back to class!

pinyin: Tā gěi Ānnà dǎ diànhuà.
english: He rings Anna.

hanzi: 喂，查理？我正在写汉字呢。
pinyin: Wèi, Chálǐ? Wǒ zhèngzài xiě Hànzì ne.
english: Hello, Charlie? I'm in the middle of writing characters.

pinyin: Ānnà, wǒ de diànnǎo yǒu wèntí.
english: Anna, there's something wrong with my computer.

pinyin: Diànnǎo de wèntí, wǒ bú huì.
english: Computers aren't my thing.

hanzi: 你问问小红吧，她什么都知道！
pinyin: Nǐ wèn wèn Xiǎohóng ba, tā shénme dōu zhīdào!
english: Ask Xiaohong. She knows everything!

pinyin: Chálǐ gěi Xiǎohóng dǎ diànhuà.
english: Charlie rings Xiaohong.

pinyin: Wèi, Chálǐ gēge! Shénme shì?
english: Hi, Charlie! What's up?

hanzi: 我的电脑上什么都没有！
pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo shàng shénme dōu méiyǒu!
english: My computer screen's completely blank!

pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo kāi le ma?
english: Is your computer turned on?

pinyin: Kāi le…… wǒ kàn kàn.
english: Course it is... hang on, I'll check.

pinyin: Diànnǎo zhēn de méiyǒu kāi.
english: It really wasn't on.

hanzi: 你是小朋友吗？电脑也不会开！
pinyin: Nǐ shì xiǎopéngyǒu ma? Diànnǎo yě bú huì kāi!
english: What are you, five? You can't even turn on a computer!

pinyin: Xièxie nǐ, xiǎo lǎoshī!
english: Thanks, little teacher!

hanzi: 星期一，大卫没有来上课。
pinyin: Xīngqī yī, Dàwèi méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
english: On Monday, David didn't turn up to class.

hanzi: 下课了，查理给他打电话。
pinyin: Xiàkè le, Chálǐ gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
english: After class, Charlie rang him.

pinyin: Wèi, Dàwèi, nǐ zěnme méiyǒu lái?
english: Hey, David. How come you weren't in class?

pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, bù xiǎng qǐchuáng.
english: I'm sick. I can't face getting up.

pinyin: Nǐ qù yīyuàn kànbìng le ma?
english: Have you seen a doctor?

pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ bù xiǎng qù yīyuàn.
english: No. I don't want to go to hospital.

hanzi: 不要在家睡了，我们去医院吧！
pinyin: Búyào zài jiā shuì le, wǒmen qù yīyuàn ba!
english: Don't just lie around at home. Let's go to the hospital!

pinyin: Xiàwǔ, tāmen dào le yīyuàn.
english: That afternoon they got to the hospital.

hanzi: 医生是小明的爸爸，张医生。
pinyin: Yīshēng shì Xiǎomíng de bàba, Zhāng yīshēng.
english: The doctor was Xiaoming's dad, Dr Zhang.

pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, Dàwèi! Nǐ zěnme le?
english: Hello, David! What's the matter?

hanzi: 我很冷，也很热，不想吃饭。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn lěng, yě hěn rè, bù xiǎng chī fàn.
english: I'm cold, then I'm hot, and I don't want to eat.

pinyin: Wǒ kàn yíxià.
english: Let me have a look.

hanzi: 不是大病。你昨天吃了什么？
pinyin: Bú shì dà bìng. Nǐ zuótiān chī le shénme?
english: It's nothing serious. What did you eat yesterday?

pinyin: Wǒ…… wǒ chī le yìdiǎnr jiǎozi.
english: I... I had a few dumplings.

pinyin: Yìdiǎnr? Wǒ kànjiàn nǐ le!
english: A few? I saw you!

pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang, zài jiǎozi diàn.
english: Last night, at the dumpling restaurant.

pinyin: Nǐ chī le sì shí gè jiǎozi!
english: You ate forty dumplings!

pinyin: Sì shí gè? Dàwèi!
english: Forty? David!

hanzi: 这个星期不要再吃饺子了。
pinyin: Zhège xīngqī búyào zài chī jiǎozi le.
english: No more dumplings this week.

pinyin: Huí jiā hǎo hǎo xiūxi ba.
english: Go home and get some proper rest.

pinyin: Nà xià gè xīngqī néng chī ma?
english: But can I have some next week?

pinyin: Kěyǐ. Shí gè, búyào sì shí gè!
english: Yes. Ten, not forty!

hanzi: 十二月十三号，北京下雪了。
pinyin: Shí èr yuè shí sān hào, Běijīng xià xuě le.
english: The thirteenth of December. It's snowing in Beijing.

hanzi: 早上六点，小狗叫查理起床。
pinyin: Zǎoshang liù diǎn, xiǎo gǒu jiào Chálǐ qǐchuáng.
english: At six a.m., the dog wakes Charlie up.

pinyin: Chálǐ hē le liǎng bēi rè chá.
english: Charlie has two hot cups of tea.

hanzi: 今天上午，他要去一个大学。
pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ, tā yào qù yí gè dàxué.
english: This morning he's off to a university to sit the HSK 1.

hanzi: 听汉语，读汉字，四十个问题。
pinyin: Tīng Hànyǔ, dú Hànzì, sì shí gè wèntí.
english: Listening and reading: forty questions.

hanzi: 八点半，安娜和查理到了大学。
pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn, Ānnà hé Chálǐ dào le dàxué.
english: At half past eight, Anna and Charlie get to the university.

pinyin: Dàwèi ne? Tā hái méiyǒu lái?
english: Where's David? Isn't he here yet?

pinyin: Bā diǎn wǔ shí wǔ, Dàwèi lái le.
english: At eight fifty-five, David turns up.

pinyin: Wǒ lái le! Wǒ méiyǒu chī zǎofàn!
english: I'm here! I didn't even have breakfast!

hanzi: 第一个问题，查理听见了：
pinyin: Dì yī gè wèntí, Chálǐ tīngjiàn le:
english: In the first question, Charlie hears:

hanzi: 那个小朋友想买一只小狗。
pinyin: Nàge xiǎopéngyǒu xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
english: 'That kid wants to buy a puppy.'

pinyin: Shì mǎi, bú shì mài! Wǒ huì!
english: That's mǎi, buy, not mài, sell! I know this one!

hanzi: 一个月后，王老师给查理打电话。
pinyin: Yí gè yuè hòu, Wáng lǎoshī gěi Chálǐ dǎ diànhuà.
english: A month later, Teacher Wang rings Charlie.

pinyin: Wèi, Chálǐ! Nǐ kàn yíxià diànnǎo!
english: Hello, Charlie! Have a look at your computer!

pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn le…… yì bǎi jiǔ shí fēn!
english: I see it... a hundred and ninety!

pinyin: Mǎi hé mài, nǐ dōu tīng duì le!
english: And you heard 'buy' and 'sell' right!

hanzi: 晚上，小明、小红、安娜和大卫都来了。
pinyin: Wǎnshang, Xiǎomíng, Xiǎohóng, Ānnà hé Dàwèi dōu lái le.
english: That evening, Xiaoming, Xiaohong, Anna and David all come round.

hanzi: 李女士给了查理一些好茶。
pinyin: Lǐ nǚshì gěi le Chálǐ yìxiē hǎo chá.
english: Ms Li gives Charlie some good tea.

pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ néng chī jiǎozi ma?
english: Am I allowed dumplings today?

pinyin: Hǎo! Shí gè, búyào sì shí gè!
english: OK! Ten, not forty!

pinyin: Xiǎohóng chàng gē, xiǎo gǒu yě jiào le.
english: Xiaohong sings, and the dog joins in.

pinyin: Míngnián shí èr yuè, wǒmen zài lái!
english: Next December, we'll be back for more!
